name: How long does exterior house painting usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does exterior house painting usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior painting project depends on several factors, including the size of your home, the condition of the existing surfaces, weather conditions, and the complexity of the architectural details. Smaller homes with well-maintained surfaces might take a few days, while larger or more complex projects with extensive preparation could take one to two weeks. We provide a detailed timeline after our initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by house size, surface condition, and complexity, typically ranging from a few days to two weeks.
